# AbstractX instructions for GitHub Copilot (VS Code)

All project rules live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it
before suggesting or changing anything; its section 0 (the operating loop) applies
to every change: retrieve the governing `[SPEC-*]` requirements, change the spec
first, check with the skills in `.agents/skills/`, record results and lessons in
git, record misses honestly, and never claim done without evidence.
